name: Sources-First Research UX
description: Users expect clickable source links immediately, not complex multi-phase analysis. Current Minto Pyramid is valuable but should be opt-in.
problem: Research button runs complex 7-phase pipeline when users just want quick sources with links
solution_direction: Show sources first, offer 'Deep Analyze' as optional follow-up
source_evidence: Bug #2: Research Button Does Wrong Thing

name: API Key Runtime Diagnostics
description: No visibility into whether API keys configured in Render are actually loading at runtime.
problem: API keys may be configured but not loading, with no debugging visibility
solution_direction: Add startup diagnostic logging with masked key status
source_evidence: Bug #1 & #4: API Keys Configured But Not Working

name: Phase Sidebar Real-Time Sync
description: Task panel only updates on button clicks, not during natural conversation progress.
problem: Users see stale spinning indicators or wrong phase numbers
solution_direction: Refresh task panel on every message for workshop bots

name: Framework Fit Detection
description: JTBD doesn't fit macro policy analysis. Bots should suggest switching when topic mismatches.
problem: Forcing JTBD on ill-fitting topics creates friction
solution_direction: Add framework fit detection with switch suggestions
source_evidence: Issue #7: JTBD Doesn't Fit Education Policy

name: Bot Flexibility vs Identity
description: Workshop bots deflect questions instead of demonstrating frameworks. Need mode for substantive content through framework lens.
problem: Bots deflect when users want direct perspective
solution_direction: Apply framework yourself as demonstration when asked

name: Multi-Agent Pipeline Orchestration
description: Automated workflows chaining multiple bots together for guided experiences.
problem: Users manually switch bots; orchestrated flows would provide guided experiences
solution_direction: LangGraph orchestration with preset pipelines (Startup Validation, Trend Analysis)

name: Cynefin Cognitive Router
description: Problem complexity classification driving bot selection. 85% infrastructure exists but not exposed.
problem: Users don't know which bot to choose; Cynefin could guide them
solution_direction: Cynefin domain classification (Clear/Complicated/Complex/Chaotic) with bot boosting

name: Workshop Pipeline State Machine
description: Formalized state machine for workshop phase progression with entry/exit criteria.
problem: Current phase tracking is loose with no completion validation
solution_direction: Entry/exit criteria per phase, required activities, structured data capture

name: Pipeline Adapters for Composable Methods
description: Methodology-specific enhancements to base Larry without full bot switch.
problem: Can't combine methodologies (TTA + Red Team) without switching bots
solution_direction: Adapter interface with prompt enhancement patterns

name: Gemini Deep Research Integration
description: 5-20 minute autonomous research agent producing 30-50+ sources with comprehensive synthesis.
problem: Current Tavily is surface-level; deep research provides comprehensive synthesis
solution_direction: Interactions API with LazyGraphRAG query enrichment

name: Per-User Memory System
description: Long-term user context beyond session. Returning users must re-explain context.
problem: Each session starts fresh; no cross-session context
solution_direction: User preference storage, problem history, assumption tracking

name: Reverse Salient Cross-Domain Discovery
description: Find innovation opportunities at concept intersections. 233 ReverseSalient nodes exist but not utilized.
problem: Graph has reverse salients but no cross-domain bridging queries
solution_direction: Bottleneck/gap identification from graph with innovation scoring

name: Collaborative Multi-User Workspaces
description: Multi-user workshop sessions since PWS methodology often involves teams.
problem: PWS workshops are typically team activities but Mindrian is single-user
solution_direction: Real-time collaboration in Chainlit with role-based contributions

name: Structured Output Validation
description: Guaranteed schema compliance for LLM outputs. Grading needs reliable structured data.
problem: LLM outputs may not match expected schema causing downstream errors
solution_direction: Pydantic models with retry and schema correction

name: Export to External Tools
description: Better output formats for Notion, Google Docs, Miro, PowerPoint.
problem: Mindrian outputs are markdown-only; users need integration with other tools
solution_direction: API integrations for popular productivity tools

name: ThinkingPanel Empty State Fix
description: Thinking boxes appear showing '0/0 - Waiting for reasoning steps' throughout conversations.
problem: Empty thinking panels confuse users
solution_direction: Check if thinking_steps has content before displaying panel
source_evidence: P2: Lawrence's Thinking Boxes Showing Empty

name: Sticky Top Roadmap
description: Top roadmap disappears as conversation builds. Right-side remains but top roadmap could be useful.
problem: Top roadmap scrolls out of view during long conversations
solution_direction: Make top roadmap sticky or auto-collapse to summary line

name: Educational Use Case Templates
description: Nested Hierarchies worked excellently for lesson plan development with 6-level hierarchy mapping.
problem: No pre-built templates for common educational use cases
solution_direction: Create starter templates for lesson planning, curriculum design, assessment design
source_evidence: Nested Hierarchies produced excellent 3-day lesson plan

name: Admin Conversation Dashboard
description: Build admin dashboard to easily review quality conversations for patterns and training data.
problem: No easy way to sample and review conversation quality
solution_direction: Dashboard with conversation sampling, quality scoring, pattern analysis
source_evidence: R&D/12 recommendation from Nested Hierarchies session

name: Safe Space vs Critical Thinking Framework
description: User identified tension between 'safe space' culture and critical thinking requirements. Systemic issue across 6 levels.
problem: Educational systems conflate emotional safety with intellectual comfort
solution_direction: Redefine 'safe space' as safe for ideas to be challenged with Rules of Critical Inquiry
source_evidence: Lawrence session: core tension identified through hierarchy mapping
